name: 332. Gemini API image generation and edit meet the contract: 400 for an undeliverable field, resolution to imageSize, thinking tokens and image counts in usage, a block as 200 with content_filter, URL input images sent (gemini image contract) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6526 regression, contract C3, C4, C5, C6. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The gemini provider there points at the fixture, whose generateContent answer is picked by the model in the path: fixture-image-delivered (one image, thoughtsTokenCount 200), fixture-image-safety (a candidate with finishReason IMAGE_SAFETY and no content, priced per image in the fixture's datasheet), fixture-image-prompt-blocked (promptFeedback.blockReason and no candidates), fixture-image-text-only (text, no image), fixture-image-empty (no candidates, no blockReason), fixture-image-thoughts-only (one image, thoughtsTokenCount with no candidatesTokensDetails, priced in the fixture's datasheet). Before the change: n and an underivable size were dropped and the request went upstream; resolution reached the vendor only as an extra field; thoughtsTokenCount was dropped; a safety finishReason was an error with no status code, a blockReason was lost in 'No candidates found in response', a text-only answer was a 200 with empty data and no marker; a URL input image of an edit was skipped. The rows read back the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire. Run the whole folder in order. The last two rows are live Vertex rows, skipped under providerErrorFixture=1: Vertex reuses the gemini provider's generateContent converters, so resolution to imageSize, URL input images as fileData and usage.output_images reach it too; they read the request Bifrost sent from extra_fields.raw_request. Vertex's block and empty-200 handling cannot be produced on demand against the live API and Vertex's host cannot be pointed at the fixture; TestVertexGeminiImageSharedConverters covers them through the provider against a local server. The request-field refusals and usage.input_images are the gemini provider's own and do not apply to Vertex. The last seven fixture rows are the file-ownership rows: two virtual keys share the fixture's one Gemini key, the first uploads a file (the fixture answers the upload with a file name of its own), the second is refused with 404 when its edit names that file's URI as an input image and nothing reaches generateContent, and the first key's edit with the same URI goes upstream as fileData.

item.name: gemini/fixture-image-delivered /v1/images/generations resolution 2K with x-bf-api-key: one upstream call, imageConfig.imageSize 2K, reasoning_tokens and output_images in usage (gemini image contract)

exec: pm.test('gemini image contract setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('data carries the one image the vendor delivered and no content_filter', function () { pm.expect(body.data, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('array').with.length(1); pm.expect(body.data[0].b64_json, pm.response.text()).to.equal('iVBORw0KGgo='); pm.expect(body.content_filter, pm.response.text()).to.equal(undefined); });

pm.test('usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens is thoughtsTokenCount', function () { pm.expect(body.usage && body.usage.output_tokens_details, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(body.usage.output_tokens_details.image_tokens, pm.response.text()).to.equal(1290); pm.expect(body.usage.output_tokens, pm.response.text()).to.equal(1300); });

pm.test('usage.output_images is the delivered count; input_images is absent on a generation', function () { pm.expect(body.usage.output_images, pm.response.text()).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.usage.input_images, pm.response.text()).to.equal(undefined); });

pm.test('the named key served the request', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-key'), JSON.stringify(pm.response.headers.toObject())).to.equal('local-error-fixture'); });

pm.test('the vendor raw response is returned', function () { pm.expect(body.extra_fields && body.extra_fields.raw_response, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.extra_fields.raw_response.usageMetadata.thoughtsTokenCount, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

wire(function (calls) { var sent = generateCalls(calls); pm.test('exactly one upstream call, resolution sent as imageConfig.imageSize and not as a top-level field', function () { pm.expect(sent, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); var upstream = JSON.parse(sent[0].body); pm.expect(upstream.generationConfig && upstream.generationConfig.imageConfig, sent[0].body).to.deep.equal({ aspectRatio: '16:9', imageSize: '2K' }); pm.expect(upstream.resolution, sent[0].body).to.equal(undefined); pm.expect(upstream.candidateCount, sent[0].body).to.equal(undefined); }); });
